name: InternetData
summary: IP, AS and domain data: an address's country, time zone, ASN, company, abuse contact, hostname and Tor, relay, bot and anycast flags on the free plan, and city-level geolocation, VPN, proxy and hosting detection on paid plans.

api_key.description: an InternetData API key (internetdata.io console > API keys). Optional: without one the free Unlimited plan answers

notes: No key is needed: the free Unlimited plan answers every lookup with country-level location, ASN, company, abuse email, hostname and the Tor, relay, bot, anycast, carrier and satellite flags (terms: https://internetdata.io/terms#no-key).
A field missing from an answer is one the plan does not include; city, region, coordinates, VPN, proxy and hosting detection need a paid plan.
Private and reserved addresses answer 200 with is_bogon true, not an error. A 429 carries Retry-After.

endpoints.name: Look up an IP address
endpoints.summary: Country, continent, time zone and currency, ASN and prefix, company, abuse email, hostname and is_tor/is_relay/is_bot/is_anycast/is_carrier/is_satellite flags for an IPv4 or IPv6 address; city, coordinates, VPN, proxy and hosting detail on paid plans.

endpoints.name: Look up an autonomous system
endpoints.summary: An AS's name, country, registry, allocation date and domain; prefixes, RPKI counts, rank, upstreams, peers and downstreams on paid plans.

asn.description: The AS number, bare or with the AS prefix.

endpoints.name: Look up a domain
endpoints.summary: Whether a domain is registered and which DNS record types (A, AAAA, MX, NS, CNAME) it has; the records, IP ranges, hosting and disposable-email flag on paid plans.
notes: Answered from InternetData's latest snapshots, not a live DNS query.
